import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_population_projections_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='Main series', header=None)
data = df.iloc[7:86, [0, 1]].dropna()
data.columns = ['Year', 'Population']
data['Year'] = data['Year'].astype(int)
data['Population'] = pd.to_numeric(data['Population'])
peak_year = data.loc[data['Population'].idxmax(), 'Year']
result = str(peak_year)
